body:
I was at a concert with three friends.  We had been smoking pot since 8 o clock in the morning... but my 'death trap' experience only started at 3.  I entered a rave like setting at the concert called the buzztent.  It was set up with massive subwoofer and lights all over.  It was a perfect setting for tripping.  Now mind you I have done large quantities of shrooms, weed, PCP, and other illegal substances but I have never had an experience like this.
The rave music was blaring and me and my three friends were watching the people in circles dance around with glow sticks.  A man than approached me with a white capsule.  He said it was ecstasy.  He offered me the pill for 25 dollars and said it was triple stacked ecstasy.  I had never done x before but since I really don't give a fuck about anything I decided to try it.  Me and my friend.. I'll call him 'bob' bought two pills.  We popped the pills nervously and felt fine.  We than got water smoked more pot and chilled.  The atmosphere was great.
About 40 minutes later I see bob puking violently on the ground, I asked him if he was alright.  My other friends than comforted him.  I than felt an energy rush and began talking to a female.  After about 10 minutes of talking I violently puked all over her and myself.  I turned around and saw bob laying on the floor immobilized puking.  I than became immobilized and started puking.  I felt a rush of intoxication.  I than broke out in a sweat and my eyes rolled in the back of my head.  My temperature was about 111.  Me and bob layed on the floor for about an hour sweating, convulsing, and regurgitating.
It was than my two friends decided we should leave because we were going to die.  I couldn't get up to leave.  My friend helped me and bob up.  We walked like we were made of jello or half retarded.  When we left the tent we fell over and layed in a pile of trash immobilized.  Everything was a blur and I was sweating profusely.  From than on my memory is like frames and pictures.
From than on my memory is like frames and pictures.
I remember walking holding on to my friend.  I remember laying on the floor of a subway train and seeing everything around me in a very hyper intoxicated manner.. it looked almost like the world on pcp x1000... than I remember being at my friends house.
The effects of this death pill lasted a good 19 hours.  I was high for 19 hours!!! Me and bob were laying in the same room.  When we woke up in the morning we were still high out of our minds so we layed down and whispered to each other.
It has been 5 days since I have taken this death pill and the first 4 days I couldn't eat or drink.. not even water.. I can eat now but my stomach still burns terribly.. I still have the shakes and every once in a while I see flashing lights and hallucinations.. I don't think I will ever be the same.
PMA sold as MDMA?
